environment.description: Same application deployed identically, but the ALB is associated with an AWS WAFv2 Web ACL. The Web ACL contains three rule groups evaluated in order: (1) AWS managed rule group AWSManagedRulesCommonRuleSet with SizeRestrictions_QUERYSTRING rule action override set to COUNT (not block) to allow long search values, (2) a custom rate-based rule limiting to 100 requests per 5 minutes per IP, and (3) AWS managed rule group AWSManagedRulesSQLiRuleSet with ALL rules in default BLOCK action and sensitivity level set to HIGH. The Web ACL default action is ALLOW. Additionally, the SQLi rule group has a scope-down statement that applies only to requests matching URI path '/api/users/search' with inspection of query string parameters. CloudWatch metrics are enabled for all rules with sampled requests.
